text:
maya: Heads-up: third-party assessors (BrightProbe) scheduled Thu. We need a short, auditable access window + artifact pipeline. Proposed: ephemeral assessor role, KMS allow for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey scoped to one key, presigned-only uploads to audit-bucket with ObjectLock, and automated teardown. PT ticket: PT-247. Thoughts?

raj: Agree. Keep permissions minimal. TTLs? How do we enforce session tagging so we can attribute actions to assessor sessions?

clara: Ops plan: provision role via OIDC for staging (1h TTL). For prod create role at start of window, attach policy, and remove at end. We'll script creation/removal and post run status to the ticket.

arjun: Suggest 90 minutes prod window so assessors can rerun failing scans. TTL for role 2h but credentials issued only within window. We'll revoke via revoke-oidc-sessions at end.

maya: Example policy snippet (attach to role):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-external-key",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/pt_ticket": "PT-247"}}
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-audit/*",
      "Condition": {"Bool": {"aws:RequestTag/presigned": "true"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

liam: Compliance: must not include customer PII. We need a named owner for redaction. Also require an NDA signature before any keys/URLs are provided.

evelyn: I'll validate the NDA template and confirm vendor signature required before we hand over any access or artifacts. If scope touches customer data we need a DPA addendum; ensure scope in writing.

devsec-bot: Guidance: all external uploads use presigned URLs and multipart uploads are allowed. Presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-audit/brightprobe/scan-2026-03-15.tgz --expires-in 3600`

raj: Add session tag requirement. We should require `aws:PrincipalTag/session_type=assessor` and `aws:RequestTag/pt_ticket=PT-247` for all KMS calls. This lets us run retrospective queries.

clara: Revert script (ops):
```
#!/bin/bash
# teardown-pt.sh
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name brightprobe-assessor --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/pt-assessor-pt247
aws iam delete-role --role-name brightprobe-assessor || true
# revoke OIDC sessions
# rotate KMS key grants if any
```

arjun: Monitoring: we'll snapshot CloudTrail logs to the audit bucket every 30m during the window. Splunk saved search to monitor KMS ops: `index=cloudtrail eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt | stats count by user, eventName` — run on a 30m schedule and persist output to S3.

liam: Also enable S3 ObjectLock (governance) for the audit-bucket and set retention 90d. We'll copy the snapshots there; don't upload raw scan outputs with PII.

maya: Who will do scan redaction? Need a name.

liam: Platform security can do automated redaction for common PII (emails, SSNs) before we handover to assessors. I'll own that for this assessment.

clara: I'll test the presign + upload flow in staging tomorrow and post results here with commands and timestamps.

maya: Owner checklist I'm creating for PT-247: 1) NDA signed (Legal) 2) Staging dry-run (Ops) 3) Policy + session tags verified (Raj) 4) Presign workflow tested (Clara) 5) Audit snapshot scheduling (Arjun) 6) Redaction pipeline ready (Liam) 7) Prod window scheduled (SRE) 8) Teardown script ready (Ops)

sre-oncall: Can host the window. Proposed slot: Thu Mar 19 09:00-10:30 PT. I'll page oncall and block calendar.

evelyn: NDA in progress, sending vendor link now. Will update PT-247 when complete.

maya: Great. Please ack ownerships in comments. I'll post final runbook link once we confirm staging test. :white_check_mark:
